cases.title: Ethylene production: process design, techno-economic and life-cycle assessments
notes: Residence time is not reported in the article text used here. It is inferred from the published fresh-ethane requirement.
The reactor dilution input uses the reported 3:1 ethane:steam volume ratio, converted to a mass ratio with molecular weights.
MSP and annual manufacturing cost use a different discounted-cash-flow boundary from the screening cost model and are shown as context.

cases.title: Decarbonization approaches for ethylene production: comparative techno-economic and life-cycle analysis
notes: The article text reports steam ratio and plant inventory but does not expose one reactor temperature/residence-time/pressure triplet.
The benchmark therefore fits residence time to fresh-ethane demand across 800–900 °C and 1–5 bar, then reports the resulting prediction envelope.
C3+ yield, heat, LCOE and GHG remain comparison outputs; they do not enter the residence-time fit.

cases.title: Development of a novel microwave-assisted process that converts waste polyethylene plastic to ethylene
notes: Residence time is derived from the published tube geometry and reactor-feed flow using an ideal-gas volumetric flow at the arithmetic-mean reactor temperature and pressure.
The same calculation using inlet and outlet states gives a residence-time bracket; the midpoint-density result is used for the central prediction.
The web surrogate was trained with a fixed 650 °C reactor inlet, while this paper reports 502.77 °C. The benchmark displays that model-form mismatch explicitly.
